title: Your Jacket Hides a Spare Button
caption:
A spare button is hidden inside your jacket

Turn the jacket inside out and look along the inside seam. Many jackets and coats come with one extra button sewn into the lining, matching the ones on the front. It is there so a lost button does not ruin the jacket years later, when the exact button is impossible to buy. The maker adds it for almost nothing, and it saves the whole garment.

Look in the side seam near the hem, or under the collar.

Send this to the person who owns a jacket with a loose button.

Follow for a new one every day.

#jacket #sewing #menswear #hiddenfeatures #everydayobjects #aigenerated

job.narration: That button inside your jacket is not decoration. It is a spare, sewn into the lining so you can replace one you lose. Matching buttons are hard to find years later. Check your jacket and you will find one.
